products.name: Himalayan Harvest Aged Basmati Rice (5 kg)
products.description: Two-year cellar-aged extra-long slender Basmati grains packed in breathable burlap and food-grade lining. Cooks fluffy, aromatic, and non-sticky for biryanis and daily meals.

reviews.title: Exceptionally fragrant slender grains
reviews.comment: Elongates cleanly to nearly triple length with genuine old-crop aroma.

products.name: Oro Verde Extra Virgin Olive Oil (750 ml)
products.description: First cold-pressed single-estate extra virgin olive oil bottled in UV-shielded dark emerald glass to preserve peppery polyphenols for finishing, roasting, and dressings.

products.description: Carbide-free hay-ripened Ratnagiri GI Alphonso mangoes bursting with saffron-gold fiberless pulp and deep tropical sweetness.
